title: RBI Penalty on Avail Financial Services Limited - Governance Violations
description: <cite index="17-6,17-7">RBI imposed a penalty of ₹6.20 lakh on Avail Financial Services Limited for violating RBI's governance and credit/investment concentration norms.</cite> <cite index="17-8,17-9">The company's Managing Director was serving as a director in two other Middle Layer NBFCs, and the company had exceeded regulatory limits for exposure to a single party.</cite>
